_about: Boards wording and buttons in the Benchmark module, swapped by tools/apply_features.py. 'autosave' always applies (boards save automatically in the browser; Export gives a .board.json file; no whole-hub 'Save board' download). 'sharing_off' applies on top only while board_sharing is false. 'shown' is the markup before, 'hidden' replaces it.

autosave.name: boards hero: how saving works
autosave.shown: Boards live in this browser as you work → Download updated file puts them inside a file → Reopen that file to carry on, then download again
autosave.hidden: Boards save automatically in this browser → Export board puts one in a small file → Colleagues import it into their own browser

autosave.name: boards header label
autosave.hidden: My boards · saved automatically in this browser · {{ savedLabel }}

autosave.name: boards header: no whole-hub 'Save board' download
autosave.shown:
<button onClick="{{ onSaveRepo }}" style="white-space:nowrap;font-family:inherit;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;color:#F6F3EC;background:rgba(246,243,236,.08);border:1px solid rgba(246,243,236,.2);border-radius:999px;padding:9px 15px;cursor:pointer" style-hover="border-color:#E8B96A;color:#E8B96A">Save board</button>
            <button onClick="{{ onImportClick }}" style="white-space:nowrap;font-family:inherit;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;color:#F6F3EC;background:rgba(246,243,236,.08);border:1px solid rgba(246,243,236,.2);border-radius:999px;padding:9px 15px;cursor:pointer" style-hover="border-color:#E8B96A;color:#E8B96A">Import board</button>

autosave.name: share sheet: export heading
autosave.shown: Board file — to send to someone
autosave.hidden: Export board — a JSON file to send to someone

autosave.name: share sheet: export description
autosave.shown: Downloads a small file. Send it however you like; the recipient uploads it with Import board and your board appears in their repository under this name, credited to you.
autosave.hidden: Downloads a small .board.json file. Send it however you like; your colleague chooses Import board and it appears in their own browser under this name, credited to you.

autosave.name: share sheet: note
autosave.shown: To keep your own boards between sessions, use Download updated file instead — it saves the whole repository with your boards inside, and that file is what you reopen next time.
autosave.hidden: Your boards save automatically in this browser as you work. Export is only for sending a copy to someone.

sharing_off.hidden: Your boards are private: they are kept in this browser, on this device, and nobody else can see them.
